title: When the Salt Burns
premise: Wendell Nystrom has spent his life in Saltmere, a valley warded against magic, training his body to survive poisons as a royal food-taster. When a mute child washes up at the valley's edge speaking the dead tongue of the pre-kingdom era, Wendell realizes the wards are failing and the child carries the last living memory of the sorcery the valley was built to imprison. Hunted by the crown's inquisitors and courted by a hidden order that wants the child's power, Wendell must choose between surrendering the boy to end the pursuit or carrying the secret into the mountains where the old war never truly ended. In the end, Wendell uses his poisoned, hardened body as a living ward—absorbing the child's dangerous inheritance into himself—and burns the valley's protection to buy the world another generation of peace, at the cost of his own memory and home.
about_author: Petra Amberdale is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval medical texts before turning to fiction. She writes quiet fantasies about ordinary people caught in the machinery of history.
